Thanks everyone. Quick tech notes from triage:
- Token refresh: the streaming runtime treats refresh-triggered 401s as hard failures because the connection-level auth token is bound to the session at open. We can implement a guarded retry that re-authenticates and reinjects a new session token into the active stream for idempotent requests. Complexity: we need a short-lived session token handshake and an accompanying client-side retry in the SDK (JS + Python).
- tool_call webhook: root cause is an earlier normalization pass that drops null/empty strings. The tool_id field is optional in some older payloads; our newer code expects it to be present. Patch is straightforward — restore forwarding of empty strings and validate downstream.

I will:
- Open a gated branch (fix/INTG-4721-auth-retry) by EOD with unit tests.
- Provide a small JS SDK patch (0.9.3-intg.1) and Python wheel for your smoke.
- Add a short changelog note and an Opt-In env var to toggle guarded retry for the smoke (so we don't flip globally).

Blocking questions for Integracom:
- Do you rely on absolute-immutable session tokens today (i.e., you won't accept mid-stream token swaps)? If so, we need to run a deeper integration.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime
